title: Where the coding actually started
description: Came in with some self-taught basics and got the real grounding here — Java and JavaFX first, then PHP alongside the web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: Databases, and my first live site
description: Learned how data actually gets stored and queried, across both SQL and NoSQL. Built Jecati Construction Services in the same stretch — a real site for a working construction business, not a throwaway class exercise.

title: Web systems, Python, and defending the work
description: The year it started feeling like engineering — building full web systems, picking up Python, and going through research and system defense, where you have to stand up and justify every decision you made.

title: First IT role
description: Joined as Part-Time IT Support while still studying. Hardware, software, and network troubleshooting — the work that turned classroom theory into knowing what actually breaks in production.

title: IT Internship
description: Migrated the full product inventory into ZOHO and handled WordPress content management — my first taste of owning a system the business genuinely depended on.

title: Built Mooserage Chatbot
description: An AI chatbot on Flask and Groq's LLaMA 3.3, with real-time streaming responses and Supabase for persistence — the first thing I built where AI was the product itself, not a feature bolted onto one.

title: Cognify CvSU-B
description: Built a licensure exam preparation system for Psychology students — mapping study material to the PRC Table of Specifications and adapting to how each student is actually performing, instead of handing everyone the same reviewer.

title: Moved from support into development
description: Grew out of the support desk and into building the systems themselves — taking on system and web development while still owning the IT support that taught me how those systems fail.

title: Graduated BS Computer Science
description: Finished the degree while already working — four years from a first Java program to shipping systems a business depends on.

title: System & Web Developer + IT Support
description: Building and maintaining the systems and web content the business runs on, while keeping the infrastructure behind them healthy. Still building on the side — most recently a Flask bank simulator with QR-code login. Open to freelance and project work.
